prompt:
Create a NEW original pixel-art animation sheet using the attached OWN Ashveil surveyor machine sheet as the canonical design reference. Only the machine is reference; do NOT copy whole reference poses as the new motion. A grim low-fantasy industrial garden surveyor: tall thin exact THREE hydraulic jointed drive legs, three circular flat support feet, small cylindrical optical head, a single dark circular lens on the FRONT, vent panel at BACK, ONE separate very thin long whip antenna from roof socket. Exactly tripod: one anterior central leg and two rear-side legs. The tiny folded calibration brackets below the lens are not human hands, not extra legs, no held tools. No fourth leg, no fourth foot, no invented arms, no weapon, no fire, no glow, no sparks, no added equipment. Keep worn bronze/gunmetal/olive rivets, sharp readable square pixel clusters and actual model identity matching reference. Core/battery/cooling are sealed internal, no exposed glowing core. Transparent PNG alpha background, no floor, no cast shadow, no text, no grid. A 4 rows by 4 columns sheet of 16 independent full-body unique drawings. Each row is one exact view: row1 FRONT facing viewer, row2 pure LEFT profile facing left, row3 pure RIGHT profile facing right, row4 BACK facing away; in back row show rear vent plate, ABSOLUTELY NO frontal round lens or face. All entire antenna tips and leg feet must fit with wide transparent gutters. Keep each figure within central 65 percent of its own cell with 12 percent transparent padding on every side. Do not connect cells or overlap. Maintain exact same viewpoint and physical limb lengths in all directions and frames. Target 1280x1280 sheet.

Motion HURT, a small physical recoil while still upright and all three feet remain attached and planted. Four chronological new poses per row: 0 neutral established stance immediately after impact with optical head drawing slightly back; 1 maximum head/chassis recoil and bent compliant knees, antenna flexed modestly opposite recoil; 2 damped counter-recoil with knees stabilizing and antenna recovering; 3 settling near upright stance, not an exact duplicate of 0. Body translations very small. Do not draw impact particles or attacking or walking. All four FRONT drawings show three leg paths/feet countable; side views can occlude the far pad naturally but do not invent an extra support. Back all four show rear panel only.
